name: SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish
tagline: Washing aid for epoxy joint grouting
summary: SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is a powder concentrate to be added to the wash water after grouting tiles with epoxy resin. It removes residual epoxy grout haze.
metaDescription: SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is a powder concentrate to be added to the wash water after grouting tiles with epoxy resin. It removes residual epoxy grout haze.
attributes: Assist with easy removes epoxy grout haze
Simply add the powder to the wash water
usage:
SikaCeram®-960 Epoxy Finish is used as an added cleaning solution added to the wash water when using epoxy grouting. 
  Please note:
The Product may be used for interior and exterior applications.
The Product may only be used by experienced professionals.
advantages: Assist with easy removes epoxy grout haze
Simply add the powder to the wash water
packaging: 750 g plastic container Refer to the current price list for available packaging variations.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text:
The Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between 0 °C and +30 °C. Always refer to the packaging.
Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage.

items.label: Yield
items.text:
75–150 m² per container
Note: Consumption data is theoretical and does not allow for any additional material due to surface porosity, surface profile, variations in level, wastage or any other variations. Apply the Product to a test area to calculate the exact consumption for the specific substrate conditions and proposed application equipment.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Sponge float
Bucket with rollers
Grout finishing tool

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Follow the mixing ratio of 1 : 100, for example, 50 g of Product to 5 litres of water.
Measure out the Product and pour into a bucket of clean water.
Stir manually using a clean tool.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
IMPORTANT
Risk of staining on natural stone
Using the Product on natural stone may result in surface staining.
Do not use the Product in combination with natural stone.
Apply on a test area if in doubt.
Protect the Product from moisture
Note:
Reseal open containers.
Preconditions
Observe information such as waiting times in the Product Data Sheet of the joint grouting product.
Use a sponge float to wash the surface of the tiles.
IMPORTANT Rinse the sponge and change the wash water frequently. Remove any smears or remaining haze.
Allow the surface to dry.
Repeat the cleaning process if there is any remaining epoxy grout haze.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean all tools and application equipment with water immediately after use. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
